title: Xanadu Basics 1a - VISIBLE CONNECTION
summary: Ted Nelson explains the original Xanadu hypertext idea of visible connection, the notion that links between documents should be shown and preserved. He argues that the Web and current document standards lost this concept.
why: HN commenters point to it as the author's own short explanation of Xanadu's core ideas, usually in threads on hypertext, linking and decentralizing the web.

quote.text: Ted Nelson recently did a series of videos on the important ideas in Xanadu. Start here
